current.text: He is projected to come off the bench. Yves Missi looks set to start at center, and a Pelicans beat reporter expects Missi to start over Queen.
New Orleans has a crowded rotation and a new head coach, Jamahl Mosley. How his minutes will be split is not clear.
He played very badly in his most recent game. One expert says that is part of why he does not get more minutes.
Experts agree he fits poorly next to Zion Williamson, so the two are unlikely to share long stretches on the floor.
He may be the best per-minute fantasy producer on the Pelicans.
He is a high-upside flyer and the best stash on the team. If Zion Williamson misses time or is traded, or Queen wins the starting job, he could return top 50 value.
A bench role hurts his value. If he stays a reserve, his draft spot is a little early.
Experts disagree on his draft price. One calls him a really good pick at 113. Another calls pick 105 early because he has no confidence in Queen's minutes.
In a mock auction he went for 6 USD, which the expert called reasonable.
With a March 28 season end, New Orleans plays 4, 4 and 3 games in our playoff weeks, which is a good playoff schedule.
New Orleans has a league-high 16 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is a hub big who works from the elbows and the free throw line. He is not a three-point spacer and has no reliable three.
He fills the stat sheet. For a forward or center he gives strong assists and steals, plus good rebounds.
He turns the ball over a lot for his position.
His FG% gives no real boost for a center, and one expert calls him a poor shooter.
Experts disagree on his defense. One calls him a bad defender with little rim protection. Another says he is actually good on defense.

note: Queen ranks 101 on Yahoo and 89 on ESPN, with average costs of 3.0 and 2.6 USD. In a 144-player league that makes him a 1 to 5 USD bench flyer, not a starter you count on, and 6 USD is the ceiling one expert called reasonable. He fits punt 3PM and punt TO builds best, giving rebounds, about 4 assists, steals and blocks from a F/C slot. Check early whether Missi holds the starting job, how many minutes Mosley gives him, and whether Zion Williamson stays healthy.
